title: RADIUS requests and authentication must recover after active-supervisor OIR

source_facts.claim: The reproduction starts with working RADIUS, removes the active supervisor, then observes authentication failure and no RADIUS packet at egress/next-hop.
The release note lists active supervisor OIR or supervisor switchover as a condition; an automation note says a switchover was used because OIR could not be automated.
A scrubnote says the issue was seen with physical OIR, not soft switchover.
Historical fix verification records a RADIUS test after supervisor switchover, but says Automation Suite: No.

requirements.description: The same RADIUS identity succeeds and its request is observed before the active supervisor event.
The run proves an active-supervisor OIR occurred; switchover equivalence is not assumed.
After the event, the run proves request egress/server receipt and successful RADIUS authentication.
